summary: Error-monitoring only: the browser Sentry client ignores more noise (errors whose stack is entirely outside the app's /_next/ bundles, extension/in-app-browser globals, 'network error', empty promise rejections, 'Login is required'), and server actions stop reporting expected UNAUTHORIZED and NOT_FOUND AppErrors to Sentry. What users see is unchanged.

statements.why: Only Sentry reporting changes; safe-action/server.ts returns the same error.code as before (the later 'if AppError return error.code' path did the same).

statements.text: Most of this change is in apps/web/instrumentation-client.ts (38 lines added).
The agent changed apps/web/instrumentation-client.ts and apps/web/src/lib/safe-action/server.ts in ways plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: Fewer errors reach the Sentry error tracker: browser-extension/in-app-browser noise, sign-in-required and not-found errors are no longer reported. Broad filters (any 'network error', any stack with no /_next/ frame) could also hide some real problems.
